_comment: Security re-audit final closure, regression guardrail #5. Every file under src/cin7/ or src/audit/ that sends a Cin7 POST or PUT-as-create must be listed here (or in exemptFiles) with an explicit classification — enforced by src/test/__tests__/cin7-post-classification.test.ts. Classification is one of: IDEMPOTENT_POST (Cin7 itself dedupes / re-sending is safe), NON_IDEMPOTENT_CREATE (carries nonIdempotentCreate:true; a retry after a network failure throws instead of silently resending), RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY (the caller has a full claim-table + reconciliation mechanism, not just the flag — the gold standard), VERIFIED_SAFE_POST_UPDATE (a PUT/POST against an already-existing, ID-targeted record — re-sending changes nothing new). See docs/security-final-closure-matrix.md section 6.2 for the investigation this registry snapshots (2026-08-18).
exemptFilesReason: debug.ts's diagnostic probes build candidate POST/PUT shapes dynamically (trial-and-error against several plausible request shapes, see testCreatePurchaseOrder) rather than one static cin7Request( call site per function, resisting this file-level classification approach. Its two genuine create paths (tryPurchaseRequest/tryPurchaseOrderLines, reachable only via debugTestCreatePurchaseOrder) already carry nonIdempotentCreate + are super-admin+AAL2-gated (Blocker 2) + audit-logged including ambiguous outcomes (Blocker 3) — tracked there, not duplicated here.
